translatorChecks.reviewerNotes: Faithful clause-by-clause translation. Preserved all 45 source paragraphs, extensive repeated curse wording, false starts, ellipses, brackets, single/double braces, and malformed quotation structure. רחלים is rendered literally as “ewes”; source tense and pronoun inconsistencies are retained.

qa.reviewNotes: Corrected after clause-by-clause comparison with the exact canonical Hebrew. Restored the anomalous future tense in ‘ewes came, and will eat everything’ (באו רחלים, ויאכלו הכל), restored the repeated ‘that’ in ‘everything that.. that they had to eat’ (כל מה ש.. שהיה), and made the final repeated שלא plus both instances of בזה explicit as ‘that he should not, that he should not study {in this …}, in this book he should not study.’ All 45 paragraph boundaries, 19 bracketed-turn paragraphs, repetitions, false starts, ellipses, braces, and malformed quotation boundaries are preserved; no unsupported addition or stage direction remains. The canonical Hebrew and staged source hash were independently confirmed.
